reports.name: USDA Grain Export Inspections (delayed by Columbus Day)
USDA Crop Progress (delayed by Columbus Day)

outlook: Grains were mixed at midday Monday as traders kept digesting Friday's USDA reports, which raised the U.S. corn yield to 181.2 bu/acre and pushed 2026-27 corn ending stocks to about 1.85 billion bushels from 1.57 billion in September. December corn was nearly unchanged near $4.80, while November soybeans were down about 8¾ cents after USDA's record 53.1 bu/acre yield and slightly higher 315 million bushel ending stocks, with Brazil's planting running about 20% complete. Chicago wheat slipped 2½ cents and Minneapolis spring wheat was unchanged; the announced Russia-Ukraine Black Sea energy ceasefire drew only a muted reaction, and rain is forecast for much of the Plains. ICE canola is closed for Canadian Thanksgiving and the USDA Minneapolis cash report was not updated for Columbus Day, so canola and cash bids shown are from Friday.
